services.name: Wildlife Committee
services.desc: At the May 2021 board meeting it was decided that the Turkey Committee will be dissolved. The turkey feeder maintenance will now be handled by the Wildlife committee. Wildlife CommitteeThis Committee has been busy feeding the animals. RRPOA has approximately 22 feeders throughout the hunt area. Every year corn is put out to help maintain the animal population. services.name: ATV Committee
services.desc: With the growth of members utilizing ATV’s within the property the board of directors saw the need to establish an ATV Committee. This committee is responsible for ATV events held during the year on the property and to assist with issues that involve ATV’s on the property. Currently various events are held throughout the year. These events are a way to bring members together to enjoy an activity and share information. Many of these events have prizes that awarded to the top participants. The board approved establishing an ATV Trail system in the Deadens area. This was created to establish and area for year round ATV riding. This was to help take the stress off the main wildlife hunting area

services.name: Fishing at River Ranch
services.desc: Hey kids, would you like to go fishing? A fishing pond has recently been placed up by the Buggy Lot. The pond is stocked with catfish right now.This pond was put in place so that parents and grandparents alike can take the time to enjoy being together. To take the time to spend relaxing and catching up on the week that has past. Or maybe just time to catch up a mess of fish!
